Name: Do It For Morris
Author: bezajel
Description:
There's nothing more motivating than a shrine to the most successful businessman in Pelican Town. Whether he's your boss or your beau, you're gonna want this poster for the wall of your shed or bedroom.

The poster can be bought from JojaMart on Mondays, or from the Joja Catalogue.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Unzip and place in your Mods folder. Content Patcher is the only requirement[/color]

[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]There is one config option: Artwork Variant. The options are Romantic or Platonic; see the images to decide which best suits your situation. The default is Romantic, obviously.[/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]This is an offshoot of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46353]Do It For Lance[/url], with thanks to Lune for permission to adapt her artwork![/color][/size]

Downloads.Description: Unzip and place in Mods folder.
